pr_title: Remove HardPodAffinitySymmetricWeight from v1alpha2 Component Config
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

This field corresponds to an old path to configure predicates. Now we have PluginConfig, which makes this field redundant and hard to maintain.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #87657

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
HardPodAffinityWeight has to be configured via PluginConfig in kubescheduler.config.k8s.io/v1alpha2
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

```docs
- [KEP]: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-scheduling/20200114-multi-scheduling-profiles.md
```

issue_context.title: Move HardPodAffinitySymmetricWeight to PluginConfig
issue_context.body:
Part of #87617, and a requirement for #85737

In `kubescheduler.config.k8s.io/v1alpha2` plugin-specific parameters should be in `.pluginConfig`.

/sig scheduling
/kind cleanup
/assign

review_comments: CC defaults.go is supposed to be the canonical place for defining default configuration values, I am concerned we are violating this practice by splitting defaults between this file and the plugins. But I guess it will not be straight forward to set default plugin configs here... so I probably we are fine for now.

The alternative would be to always set the PluginConfig here. I just liked better having a clean PluginConfig when you want defaults.

I don't think it's far from straightforward.

by removing this default, haven't you effectively changed the behavior of existing v1alpha1 config files? previously, it would get a default weight of 1. now, it remains nil and the conversion-time setting to append to plugin args isn't exercised, right?

Correct.
An alternative would be to keep these lines and only skip from conversion if it's the default.

What I was going for in v1alpha2 is to leave nil for default plugin arguments.
Or we could just always fill the PluginConfig for v1alpha1, but not for v1alpha2. WDYT?
*has* the default behavior changed for v1alpha1 config files that do not specify a HardPodAffinitySymmetricWeight field (from an end-user's perspective, in what the scheduler actually does)?

Ok, that wasn't clear. As long as the resulting scheduler functions the same, that's reasonable. Moving it out of API defaulting makes that hard to test (and will make it easy to accidentally change defaults in the future without realizing, which isn't great)
The flexibility of the new plugins API makes it a bit harder for validation and defaults. But #87784 and #88093 should alleviate some of that.
